record: Freeze record of the Phase 3 comparison set E1 to E6: hashes, editions, rules and provenance only; no question, evidence or rubric text.

decision.what: the case design of E1 to E6 and, the same day, a ruling on the one source conflict the verifier raised; both are recorded verbatim in the private decision record, hashed under files
decision.applied_by: Claude (claude-opus-5-5) on 2026-11-21; the final wording applies the decisions and was not approved line by line

fixed_before_comparison: Frozen before any retrieval, ranking or generation on E1 to E6 and before any cell of E1 to E6 was in the books (active ledger SHA-256 under books_at_freeze).

provenance.drafted: AI-drafted by Claude (claude-opus-5-5) on 2026-11-21 from the pdftotext output of the two hash-verified BAG commentaries, without running retrieval, ranking, embedding or generation on any candidate question.
provenance.drafting_qualifications: The drafter knew from rubric.json (D1 review_focus) that retrieval at k=5 ranked the D1 evidence pages at ranks 6 and 7, and one case (E1) reuses a passage that is dev case D1's evidence. The set is therefore not called held-out or blind.
provenance.verification: The repo's verifier agent (claude-opus-5-5, fresh context, did not draft the cases) checked every case against the two commentaries without any retrieval or generation: a first pass (1 blocker, brought to Erhan and resolved by his ruling; 9 should-fix; 13 nits) and a re-check after the fixes (1 blocker, 1 should-fix, 6 nits), all resolved; the last changes were checked mechanically, not by the verifier a third time. Reports kept locally with the set.

source_documents.path: data/raw/bag/al/2026-01-01/Kommentar zu den Änderungen des Anh. 3 KLV per 01.01.26.pdf
data/raw/bag/al/2026-07-01/Kommentar zu den Änderungen des Anh. 3 KLV per 01.07.26_final.pdf

files.holds: each case's id, question and editions, nothing else: the only file run_comparison.py reads
per case: kind, question, editions, reference expectation and the gold evidence items (the required-evidence denominator), with section anchors
per case: expected status, required claims with supports and check terms, optional background, gaps to name, errors to record, review focus; the scoring and reporting rules
Erhan's case decisions verbatim and his ruling on the verifier's blocker

question_sha256: SHA-256 of the question's UTF-8 bytes, as run_comparison._sha256 and evidence_agent compute it; every reservation of a cell records it with the sorted editions, so the books of a run can be matched to this set.

scoring_rules.required_claims: Only required claims are scored. A claim of kind gap (naming a stated absence) has no support quote, is scored by human review and adds nothing to the required-evidence denominator.
scoring_rules.required_evidence: A case's required-evidence denominator is its gold evidence items, which equal the supports of its required claims; optional supports are outside it. Evidence Recall with zero required evidence items is N/A, never 0.
scoring_rules.coverage: A passage covers an item when it is from the item's edition and page and contains the quote (NFC, whitespace folded; evaluation.covering). Section and occurrence anchors are checked by a person.
scoring_rules.check_terms: Aids only, never a verdict; null means human review only.
scoring_rules.optional_background: May be stated; never required, never scored; a wrong optional statement is recorded as an error, never as lost credit.
scoring_rules.must_not: Errors a person records against an answer; they never add credit.
scoring_rules.expected_status: answered, partial or insufficient_evidence (generation.STATUSES): the status an answer should have if all required evidence were in its context.

reporting: E1 is reported separately from E2 to E6 (known D1 passage overlap).
E4 and E5 are January-only questions; B (fixed10) receives 10 of the January commentary's 11 passages there.
E2's edition filter excludes the January commentary for every condition (the agent's search accepts only the case's editions), so E2 does not test edition selection.
A case without required evidence items has Evidence Recall N/A, never 0.

corpus_at_freeze.how: question-free build of the hash-verified corpus (no ranking, no question embedding, no model call)

reproduce: python3 -c "import json,hashlib,sys; [print(c['id'], hashlib.sha256(c['question'].encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()) for c in json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8'))['cases']]" tools/commentary_rag/local/2026-11-21-phase3-E-set/runner/cases.json
